title: Personal Checking: overdraft transfer fee drawn from an ineligible savings account
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Personal Checking account, or the agent reviewing the account, examines an overdraft protection transfer fee for bank error. It decides whether the savings account that funded the transfer was allowed to serve as an overdraft protection source.

## Formal clauses

1. **Which fee.** This bank-error review concerns the account's most recently posted overdraft transfer fee. Any earlier overdraft transfer fee is reviewed under the general Personal Checking fee refund rules.
2. **Eligible sources only.** An overdraft protection transfer may be drawn only from a savings account whose savings tier is designated, in the savings product terms, as eligible to serve as an overdraft protection source.
3. **Tracing the transfer.** The transfer that caused the fee is the entry named as the fee's source item on the checking account.
4. **Tracing the savings account.** The source savings account of that transfer is the account named as that transfer's counterparty. Its eligibility is read from that savings account's tier in the savings product terms.
5. **Bank error on this ground.** The fee is a bank error when that source savings tier is not eligible to serve as an overdraft protection source.
6. **Source not on record.** When the source savings account is not on the customer's record, the eligibility condition cannot be established and only the amount condition is judged.

## Input, judgement, output

```
Most recent overdraft transfer fee on the checking account
  -> its source item: the overdraft protection transfer
    -> that transfer's counterparty: the source savings account
      -> that savings account's tier in the savings product terms
         eligible as a source?   No  -> bank error on this ground
                                 Yes -> no bank error on this ground
         account not on the customer's record -> this ground cannot be established
```

## Condition table

| Source savings account on the customer's record | Its tier eligible as an overdraft protection source | Reading on this ground |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Bank error |
| Yes | Yes | No bank error on this ground |
| No | Cannot be read | Cannot be established; only the amount condition is judged |

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "the savings account the checking account is linked to today decides". **Correct basis:** the source is the counterparty of the transfer that caused the fee, traced from the fee's own source item.
- **Wrong reading:** "an older transfer fee on the account is judged the same way here". **Correct basis:** this review concerns the most recently posted overdraft transfer fee; earlier ones are reviewed under the general fee refund rules.
